        r.r_name AS customer_region,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.o_orderdate) AS order_month,

)

            PARTITION BY customer_region ORDER BY order_month
        ), 0), 2
    ) AS mom_growth_pct
FROM monthly_customers
ORDER BY customer_region, order_month

  FROM orders

recent_customers AS (
  -- Customers who ordered in most recent year (1998)
  SELECT DISTINCT o_custkey
  FROM orders
  WHERE o_orderdate >= '1998-01-01' AND o_orderdate < '1999-01-01'
),
customer_regions AS (
  SELECT c.c_custkey, n.r_regionkey
  FROM customer c
  JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
)
SELECT 
  r.r_name AS region,
  COUNT(DISTINCT lc.o_custkey) AS legacy_customers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rc.o_custkey IS NOT NULL THEN lc.o_custkey END) AS retained,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rc.o_custkey IS NOT NULL THEN lc.o_custkey END) /

LEFT JOIN recent_customers rc ON lc.o_custkey = rc.o_custkey
